summary: serve-mimo26-flash.sh starts MiMo-V2.6-Flash with DFlash and the b12x serving flags
compatibility: serve-mimo26-flash.sh now defaults to DFlash and an FP8 KV cache and pins revision 5711b268; KV_CACHE_DTYPE=bfloat16 and NUM_SPECULATIVE_TOKENS=0 restore the previous cache and no speculation.
details: DFlash drafting (7 tokens) with TP drafting and adaptive verification, FP8 KV cache by default, vision and audio via MiMoV2OmniForCausalLM, and the MiMo b12x switches.
MODEL_REVISION moves to 5711b268, the first revision with a valid dflash/config.json.
